parties.respondent: The Then Rajendra Agricultural University (now Dr. Rajendra Prasad Central Agricultural University) & Ors.

summary: Default retirement benefit scheme under university statute: General Provident Fund-cum-pension-cum-gratuity applicable unless employee opts for Contributory Provident Fund; non-exercise of option results in automatic inclusion in pension scheme; office order of 2008 reaffirms this; High Court decisions in similar cases cited; failure to include appellant in scheme despite no opt-in to CPF held erroneous; impugned judgment set aside.
legal_provisions_cited: Office Order Memo No. 2306/RAU, Pusa dated 21.02.2008
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; impugned judgment set aside; appellant entitled to inclusion in General Provident Fund-cum-pension-cum-gratuity scheme.
